free_tier.stated: CNY 33 per month for a Los Angeles VPS on the three-network AS9929 return path: 1 core, 1 GB RAM, 10 GB SSD, 800 GB a month, a 30 Mbps port, one IPv4, on an E5-2680v4. The CN2 GIA row of the same shape is CNY 40 a month, the dual-ISP residential-IP row on AS9929 is CNY 44 a month at 30 Mbps, the dual-ISP AS4837 row is CNY 44 a month at 50 Mbps, and the Hong Kong direct row is CNY 39 a month for the same 1 GB shape on a 5 Mbps port. Quarterly rows start at CNY 120 and annual rows at CNY 388 for 2 cores, 4 GB, 40 GB and 2 TB a month. The offer states the discount code is recurring, that the renewal price does not rise, and that no real-name registration is required.
